## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this PR do and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing API to change)
- [ ] Docs / chore / refactor (no functional change)

## Verify loop

- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run pyright`
- [ ] `uv run pytest --cov` (100% line + branch)

## Changelog

- [ ] Added an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Not user-visible (no changelog entry needed)

<!-- Tradeoffs you considered, alternatives you ruled out, follow-ups, etc. -->
